meta.name: vesper
meta.author: Jovinull
meta.description: A derelict machine-planet slowly wakes as its ancient industry runs again. Alpha build: the VESPER planet and its campaign (Play > Campaign, then VESPER). Chapter One, The Silent Basin: First Awakening, Resonance Fault and The Buried Foundry, linked by its own tech tree and the records you recover. Chapter Two opens with Deep Signal: below the basin, three relays of an ancient network must run at once, on power and resonance cores, through a synchronization. Central Control follows: split your grid between two ancient protocols, containment that holds the vents shut and recovery that brings the complex back, and reactivate it. The maps can also be played on their own (Play > Custom Game), and so can Resonance Works, a standalone map of the resonance industry: dynamos that burn resonance cores for power and containment fields that hold the pulses back.
